title: MarineLife-16K: An Attribute-Rich Video-Text Dataset for Motion-Aware Marine Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.33478v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Marine video understanding is crucial for a wide range of real-world applications. However, existing marine video datasets suffer from limitations, including the limited number of data samples, fine-grained text descriptions, and detailed visual attributes. To address these limitations, we introduce a large-scale, video-text dataset featuring rich, in-the-wild visual attributes tailored for complex marine environments. Our dataset comprises 2,000 video-text pairs annotated with 13 attributes covering up to four objects per scene, object visual/geometric properties, behaviors, environmental context, and camera motion, spanning diverse lighting conditions, times of day, and 7 countries. From these annotations, we generate 16,080 video-question pairs (12,080 multiple-choice, 4,000 open-ended). translated_abstract: 海洋视频理解对于广泛的现实世界应用至关重要。然而，现有的海洋视频数据集存在诸多局限，包括数据样本数量有限、细粒度文本描述不足以及缺乏详细的视觉属性。为了解决这些局限，我们引入了一个大规模的视频-文本数据集，其特点是包含为复杂海洋环境量身定制的丰富真实场景视觉属性。我们的数据集包含2,000个视频-文本对，标注了13种属性，涵盖每个场景中最多四个物体、物体的视觉/几何特性、行为、环境背景以及相机运动，跨越多样的光照条件、一天中的不同时段以及7个国家。基于这些标注，我们生成了16,080个视频-问题对（12,080个多选题，4,000个开放性问题）。此外，我们在视频问答和视频描述任务上对专有和开源视频大语言模型进行了基准测试。我们发现（i
tldr: 该论文提出了MarineLife-16K，一个包含13种丰富视觉属性标注的大规模海洋视频-文本数据集，并通过对视频大语言模型在问答与描述任务上的基准测试，揭示了现有模型在海洋视频理解方面的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MarineLife-16K, a large-scale video-text dataset with rich attribute annotations for marine video understanding, and benchmarks proprietary and open-source video-LLMs on video QA and captioning tasks.
